name: Speed limit (20 km/h)
meaning: Maximum permitted speed is 20 km/h.

name: Speed limit (30 km/h)
meaning: Maximum permitted speed is 30 km/h.

name: Speed limit (50 km/h)
meaning: Maximum permitted speed is 50 km/h.

name: Speed limit (60 km/h)
meaning: Maximum permitted speed is 60 km/h.

name: Speed limit (70 km/h)
meaning: Maximum permitted speed is 70 km/h.

name: Speed limit (80 km/h)
meaning: Maximum permitted speed is 80 km/h.

name: End of speed limit (80 km/h)
meaning: The 80 km/h speed restriction ends here; other applicable limits still apply.

name: Speed limit (100 km/h)
meaning: Maximum permitted speed is 100 km/h.

name: Speed limit (120 km/h)
meaning: Maximum permitted speed is 120 km/h.

name: No passing
meaning: Overtaking motor vehicles is prohibited.

name: No passing for vehicles over 3.5 metric tons
meaning: Vehicles over 3.5 metric tons must not overtake motor vehicles.

name: Right-of-way at the next intersection
meaning: You have priority at the next intersection; proceed with caution.

name: Priority road
meaning: Traffic on this road has priority at intersections until the priority status ends.

name: Yield
meaning: Give way to traffic on the intersecting road; stop if necessary.

name: Stop
meaning: Come to a complete stop and give way before proceeding safely.

name: No vehicles
meaning: Vehicles are prohibited from entering this road.

name: Vehicles over 3.5 metric tons prohibited
meaning: Vehicles over 3.5 metric tons are prohibited from this road.

name: No entry
meaning: Entry is prohibited from this direction.

name: General caution
meaning: An unspecified hazard is ahead; slow down and assess conditions.

name: Dangerous curve to the left
meaning: A dangerous bend to the left is ahead.

name: Dangerous curve to the right
meaning: A dangerous bend to the right is ahead.

name: Double curve
meaning: A series of bends is ahead; approach with caution.

name: Bumpy road
meaning: An uneven road surface is ahead.

name: Slippery road
meaning: The road surface may be slippery; reduce speed and avoid sudden inputs.

name: Road narrows on the right
meaning: The road becomes narrower on the right.

name: Road work
meaning: Road construction or maintenance is ahead.

name: Traffic signals
meaning: Traffic lights control the road ahead.

name: Pedestrians
meaning: Pedestrians may be on or crossing the road ahead.

name: Children crossing
meaning: Children may cross the road ahead, often near a school or play area.

name: Bicycles crossing
meaning: Cyclists may cross or enter the road ahead.

name: Beware of ice/snow
meaning: Ice or snow may make the road slippery.

name: Wild animals crossing
meaning: Wild animals may cross the road ahead.

name: End of all speed and passing limits
meaning: Previously imposed speed and overtaking restrictions end.

name: Turn right ahead
meaning: Traffic must turn right ahead.

name: Turn left ahead
meaning: Traffic must turn left ahead.

name: Ahead only
meaning: Traffic must continue straight ahead.

name: Go straight or right
meaning: Only straight-ahead or right-turn movements are permitted.

name: Go straight or left
meaning: Only straight-ahead or left-turn movements are permitted.

name: Keep right
meaning: Pass the obstruction on its right side.

name: Keep left
meaning: Pass the obstruction on its left side.

name: Roundabout mandatory
meaning: Follow the mandatory circulating direction at the roundabout.

name: End of no passing
meaning: The restriction on overtaking ends.

name: End of no passing by vehicles over 3.5 metric tons
meaning: The overtaking restriction for vehicles over 3.5 metric tons ends.
